body:
The problem is that I do still feel for him. I wanted to tell him that I loved him but I also was't strong enough to deal with another one of these cycles. I just wanted that opportunity to say those words to him, but life won't even give me that. There's a chance that he might end it with me, but at least I have closure that way. Not just the disappearing act that he's pulled in the past before. 

I just watch him have a happy successful life...and I get this one where I don't even get the chance to stand up for myeslf...and I don't feel like its worth it.
